name: Trixie Glimmer Smith
source:
First year student and all around useless layabout, Trixie wants to succeed in her studies but isn't finding that so easy. Thankfully her friend Nikita has been bailing her out. Sadly, Trixie now owes Nikita a pretty big favour, hopefully it won't involve any haunted plays.

Trixie has been transitioning for almost half a year but still struggles with her feelings regarding it, particulary feelings of guilt around her family. Hopefully she can make some friends and open up about it.

Trixie is pretty sure she is asexual, but her fanfiction makes her doubt this.

[From the official art book.]
